name: PipelineNews Atlas V9 deep-link timestamp-folder successor

datasets.name: sector_items
datasets.grain: one retained sector intelligence item from one explicit source item or one pinned owner-export record

datasets.name: sector_item_topics
datasets.grain: one explicit topic assignment for one sector intelligence item

datasets.name: sector_project_bindings
datasets.grain: one evidence-backed project-binding decision for one sector intelligence item and REPD reference

physical_layout.empty_dataset_policy: typed Parquet is required; an empty file has no column chunks, so codec evidence is NOT_APPLICABLE_EMPTY while schema/key/null readback remains gated

sector_projection.binding_label: SECTOR CONTEXT ONLY — QUERY PROJECT IDENTITY REMOVED

source.dataset: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database Q2 2026

project_intelligence.scope: live solar and battery-storage projects in the DESNZ REPD Q2 2026 spine (not operational, refused, withdrawn or abandoned)

network.measure: perpendicular distance to the circuit, not to a sampled vertex

grid_proximity.scope: live solar and battery-storage projects in the DESNZ REPD Q2 2026 spine (not operational, refused, withdrawn or abandoned)

table_locality_sort.activation: fetched once during boot, before the first table paint; fails soft
table_locality_sort.mutates_existing_dashboard: adds TOWN and POSTCODE columns and makes CAPACITY, COUNTY, TOWN and POSTCODE headings sortable

provenance.postcode: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database, column 'Post Code', Open Government Licence v3.0. Copied, never derived.
provenance.town: Resolved at build time from the REPD postcode via the ONS Postcode Directory (api.postcodes.io), preferring ONS Built-Up Area, then civil parish, then electoral ward. Where the register carries no postcode, the last usable segment of the REPD Address line is used and marked town_source='derived'. Null where unsourceable; never guessed.
provenance.authority: DESNZ REPD, column 'Planning Authority', OGL v3.0. Carried in the payload. NOTE: the gridatlas study spine (master.tsv) carries this same planning-authority value in a column it calls 'town'. It is the local planning authority, not a settlement -- 'Scottish Government (S36)' is one of its values. This cartridge keeps the two apart.

grid_distance_column.activation: fetched once during boot, before the first table paint; fails soft
grid_distance_column.mutates_existing_dashboard: adds a GRID column and a grid-distance sort mode to the project table

maturity.means: The measurement is published and checked. BETA marks what it does not yet cover, so it can be used for screening with its limits known. It is not a warning that the number is unreliable.
not_covered: 11 kV beyond an estimated UKPN layer, the voltage most sub-5 MW distribution connections are actually made at
the point of connection, which is not the register centroid the distance is measured from
connection queue position, curtailment and contracted capacity
maturity.cannot_be_inferred: Fault level and thermal headroom. These are properties of the network, not of the geometry: they depend on DNO data such as source impedance, fault infeed and existing committed connections, and are established by a connection study. No distance, at any precision, implies them.

provenance.geometry: OpenStreetMap-derived overhead line and substation layers, ODbL-1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.
provenance.projects: DESNZ Renewable Energy Planning Database, Open Government Licence v3.0.
provenance.mathematics: Ventusltd/grid-distance-maths src/geodesy.py, haversine at R = 6378.137 km, point projected onto the segment on a local tangent plane. Every published distance was re-measured against it at build time and reproduced within the source payload's own rounding.

capacity_range_filter.activation: inline control; no payload, no fetch
capacity_range_filter.mutates_existing_dashboard: adds a PROJECT SIZE range filter and the mw_min / mw_max URL parameters

scale.why_not_linear: Measured over all 7,680 projects the median is 12.3 MW, the 75th percentile is 40 MW and 98% sit under 500 MW. A linear 1-5000 track would put the 30-40 MW band inside 0.2% of its length. The ladder thickens where the register is dense and still reaches 5,000.
scale.exact_values: The number boxes accept any value in range, so a band the ladder does not carry is still reachable. Only the slider snaps.

capacity_range_filter.filters_only: This is a view control. It never redefines the pipeline: the register's own floor is 1 MW, the largest record is 4,100 MW, and clearing the filter restores every qualifying record.

grid_actions_inline.activation: fetched once during boot, before the first table paint; fails soft
grid_actions_inline.mutates_existing_dashboard: removes the GRID column and places GRID and SUB inside ACTIONS

placement.was: a sortable GRID column between POSTCODE and OPERATOR
placement.now: GRID and SUB chips in the ACTIONS cell, after MAP
placement.why: Measured from the published bytes, the GRID column's right edge sat at ~1,430px while a 1366px laptop shows ~1,056px of table; it only cleared the fold at about 1920px. Beside MAP it is reachable at any width, and MAP opens the Atlas the distances are measured against.
placement.cost: A sortable heading needs a column, so click-to-sort on distance is gone. Sorting is not: grid_asc and grid_desc remain in the SORT control.

substation_scope.why: 33 kV and above. 11 kV is rare for utility-scale export and where it occurs is often a private network behind the meter, so it is not a screening signal.
substation_scope.layer: All 5,800 substations in the Atlas layer carry at least 33 kV; 4,342 carry 33 kV itself. Nothing is excluded, so the published substation distance is already the nearest 33 kV+ substation.
substation_scope.why_it_matters: A scheme of a few tens of MW connects at a substation, not to a conductor it sits under. Median distance to a 33 kV+ substation is 1.52 km against 6.44 km to a 33 kV circuit, and for the 30-40 MW band the substation is the closer of the two for 68% of projects.

grid_actions_inline.cannot_be_inferred: Fault level and thermal headroom. These are properties of the network, not of the geometry: they depend on DNO data such as source impedance, fault infeed and existing committed connections, and are established by a connection study. No distance, at any precision, implies them. Proximity to a mapped substation is not capacity at it.

provenance.geometry: OpenStreetMap-derived overhead line and substation layers, ODbL-1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors.
provenance.mathematics: Ventusltd/grid-distance-maths src/geodesy.py. All 3,047 published substation distances were re-measured against it at build time and reproduced within the source payload's own rounding.

news_relevance_filter.activation: applied to the news payload at ingest; no payload of its own
news_relevance_filter.mutates_existing_dashboard: filters the newspaper to project-bound stories and removes the geography filters

rule.kept: eligible_for_news_signal AND canonical_relevant AND role == PRIMARY_MATCH AND repd_ref is not empty
rule.source: every condition is a field already in the news payload; nothing is inferred or re-classified here

news_relevance_filter.why_the_caption_mattered: Withheld rows carry an empty repd_ref but were still printed under a project name taken from elsewhere, so a New Jersey storage consultation appeared as an update on Wilton International and a care-home award appeared under The Grange solar farm. A wrong story is clutter; a wrong story captioned with a real scheme is a false statement about that scheme.
